newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-L.Lease values Darling Park A$984 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-L.Lease values Darling Park A$984 mln.

text.p: Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Thursday a prospectus lodged for its Sydney commercial property project, the Darling Park project, puts a value of A$984 million on the project by December 1999.

Earlier today, Lend Lease said it would raise A$325 million through a vehicle called the Darling Park Trust which would acquire 50 percent of the existing office building at the site and 50 percent of stage two of the development of the project.
The project's fund manager, Andrew Kentmann, told reporters at a briefing that the existing IBM tower building was valued in the prospectus at A$360 million as at December 1, this year.
